name: higgsfield-operators
_source: Operator (+18) and Buyer-map (+10) dimensions from Higgsfield Signal OS (https://higgsfield-signal-os.netlify.app/).
_scope: People. Signal OS's first principle is 'operator before logo' — a famous account with no AI/creative/growth owner is not a Prime target. This config scores the owner.
_use: Run after an account clears icp.higgsfield-accounts.json, or straight at a role: find "heads of creative operations at NA agencies" --deep 10 --icp assets/icp.higgsfield-operators.json
_fidelity: Ordering, not Signal OS arithmetic. Boost saturates at +30.
_must_any: The person must sit near content, video or creative work. Without this gate a senior title alone would rank.
_boost: Operator seniority and function. Titles usually arrive via the Google snippet, since LinkedIn hides job history on public profiles.
_penalty: People who cannot buy or pilot anything.
_audience: Followers. Operators are not influencers — a 2k-follower Head of Creative Ops is an excellent target — so the band is wide and the weight is deliberately lower than the account config.
_signals: `hiring` on a person usually means they are building a team, which is both a catalyst and evidence of budget.
